info.name: Nasaq — Financial Module Full Verified Walkthrough (self-contained, run top to bottom)
info.description:
Fully self-contained — registers a fresh school, logs in, does the minimum academic setup (stage, 2 grade levels, academic year, 1 class), then exercises every fix from the Phase 1-4 financial implementation plan end to end. Nothing to set up by hand: run collection top to bottom against the 'Nasaq — Financial Walkthrough' environment and every ID chains automatically.

IMPORTANT: students are created via POST /students WITHOUT an inline classId, then enrolled via POST /enrollments. This is deliberate — StudentsService.create()/update() build the Enrollment document directly and never call FinancialRecordService.createOrUpdateRecord(), so creating a student with an inline classId will NOT produce a financial record.

--- BUG FIXES REFLECTED IN THIS VERSION ---

Fix 1 — schoolId missing from upserted StudentFinancialRecord (PRIMARY 404 bug):
findOneAndUpdate with upsert:true never included schoolId in $setOnInsert. The tenantScopedPlugin only injects schoolId into the query FILTER, not the inserted document body. New documents were created without schoolId, making them invisible to all subsequent tenant-scoped reads. Fixed by explicitly reading tenantLocalStorage.getStore().schoolId and adding it to $setOnInsert.

Fix 2 — E11000 duplicate-key errors now return HTTP 409 Conflict (not 500):
GlobalExceptionFilter previously had no handler for MongoServerError / code 11000, so raw DB errors leaked as 500 Internal Server Error. A new else-if branch now maps any MongoServerError with code 11000 to 409 Conflict with a clean Arabic message. Duplicate FeeConfig tests (A3) now expect 409.

Fix 3 — Wrong populate field on classId:
.populate('classId', 'roomNumber academicYear gender') used non-existent field 'academicYear'. Corrected to 'academicYearId' in both find() and findOne() on FinancialRecordService.

DB Cleanup required for pre-fix records:
Any StudentFinancialRecord documents created before Fix 1 will be missing schoolId and can never be found by tenant-scoped reads. Run in MongoDB shell: db.studentFinancialRecords.deleteMany({ schoolId: { $exists: false } }) — then re-enroll the affected students.
